name: Iris Detail
description: Analyzes iris pattern detail and consistency
algorithm: Iris Detail — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes iris detail and rendering quality for deepfake detection:

1. **虹膜区域提取**: The iris is precisely segmented per frame using circular/elliptical fitting between pupil and limbus (iris-sclera boundary). The iris texture region is extracted and geometrically normalized to a canonical representation (polar coordinates, normalized radius).

2. **虹膜纹理分析**: Natural iris texture contains complex radial structures (collarette, crypts, furrows, pigment spots) forming a unique biometric pattern. The method analyzes iris texture complexity, radial structure presence, and fine detail quality. AI-generated irises often lack the intricate natural iris texture, appearing either too smooth, too regular, or showing physically implausible patterns.

3. **Bilateral虹膜比较**: Both irises of the same person should show similar (but not identical) structural characteristics — same color, similar complexity, matching pigmentation patterns. The method compares iris features between eyes. Deepfakes may produce irises with inconsistent appearance (different colors, different detail levels) between left and right eyes.

4. **虹膜-瞳孔Dynamics**: The pupil-to-iris ratio should respond to light conditions. The method checks whether pupil size is consistent between both eyes and appropriate for the scene illumination. Deepfakes may produce asymmetric pupils or pupil sizes inconsistent with the lighting environment.

5. **时间虹膜稳定性**: Iris texture is a physical structure that doesn't change between frames — only viewing angle and pupil dilation change. The method tracks iris texture consistency (using iris code distance metrics) across frames. Frame-to-frame iris texture changes indicate AI generation where iris detail is independently rendered per frame.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through iris detail analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
